top_violation_types.title: Medication Records - Name of Medication (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, medication was given to a child, and the information was not recorded on an administration form.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The center director has been unable to meet director responsibility requirements. Repeated deficiencies in the areas of background checks and fire safety have occurred.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director has not been present at the operation for at least 30% or 75% of the time.

top_violation_types.title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not documented any severe weather drills for the year.

top_violation_types.title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not documented any lock down drills for the year.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children where observed watching cartoons while combined in the gym.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.
